quant-au-riche-avenir: A teenage boy seen from behind writing in a notebook at a desk by a window of a quiet provincial house, a stack of unanswered letters beside him, an older woman's coat on a chair.
comedie-classique: An autumn morning in a Paris apartment: an unmade bed, a single endless ribbon of paper winding across the room and out of the window toward the rooftops, a clock showing early morning.
la-femme-changee-en-buche: A young woman seen from behind walking down a stairway into a dilapidated underground palace with peeling red and gold walls, guttering flames, a burnt log lying on the floor.
en-famille: A young woman seen from afar on a muddy country road between hostile village houses with closed shutters, a barking dog at a gate, a distant family house lit for a party.
un-temps-de-saison: A deserted holiday village in sudden cold autumn rain, closed shutters, a lone man in a raincoat seen from behind on a wet road, an empty milk can by a farm gate.
la-sorciere: Twin girls seen from behind in a suburban garden at dusk, watching crows rising into the sky above identical small houses, a mother's silhouette in a lit kitchen window.
la-naufragee: A mermaid seen from behind lying stranded on a stone quay of the Seine at dawn, misty golden light like a Turner painting over the river and bridges.
hilda: An elegant bourgeois living room with an empty chair, a cleaning bucket and apron set beside it, a man's work cap on a table, tall windows onto a provincial street.
la-diablesse-et-son-enfant: A small figure with little black goat hooves walking at night along a village lane, doors closing and lamps going out in the windows, a forest at the edge of the village.
rosie-carpe: A young woman and a small boy seen from behind waiting at a tropical Guadeloupe airport arrivals area, palm trees, hot sunlight, nobody coming to meet them.
papa-doit-manger: A man in a bright elegant suit seen from behind standing at the door of a modest suburban apartment building at night, a dining table glimpsed through a window.
les-paradis-de-prunelle: A boy seen from behind sitting alone on a park bench in summer, beside him a pale girl's shadow, a dreamlike staircase of gardens rising into the clouds.
tous-mes-amis: A lakeside at dusk with an abandoned woman's handbag on a wooden jetty, a provincial town and a schoolhouse in the distance, a vintage record sleeve on the grass.
les-serpents: An isolated farmhouse lost in tall summer cornfields on Bastille Day, fireworks in the evening sky, an older woman seen from afar waiting at the closed door, snakes coiled in the grass.
rien-d-humain: A dim city apartment seen through a half-open door, a suitcase in the hallway, ghostly translucent curtains, a neighbour's door across the landing.
autoportrait-en-vert: A flooding river near a house in the French south-west, green trees bending, distant figures of women in green dresses seen from afar on the riverbank.
le-souhait: A snowy Christmas night, a child's bedroom full of toys seen through a window, a small girl seen from behind standing in the doorway, two glowing red hearts in the room.
mon-coeur-a-l-etroit: Narrow streets of Bordeaux under a heavy grey sky, a tram line, a couple seen from behind walking close together while shadows of passers-by turn away.
les-grandes-personnes: A village schoolhouse at dusk, small empty desks seen through the window, a group of older adults seen from afar talking in a garden, a lone woman standing apart.
y-penser-sans-cesse: A Berlin street with tram wires and old facades in pale light, a woman and a small child seen from behind walking hand in hand, faint ghostly silhouettes along the walls.
ladivine: A dark forest road abroad with a large dog standing at the edge of the trees, a family car parked, three dresses of different generations hanging on a line in front of a small house.
la-cheffe-roman-d-une-cuisiniere: A professional restaurant kitchen in Bordeaux, copper pots, fresh vegetables and herbs, a cook seen from behind in a white apron working alone in the morning light.
trois-pieces: Three stage scenes side by side under theatre lights: a letter on a table in a quiet house, a modernist Berlin apartment block, a port town square with a podium and bunting.
un-pas-de-chat-sauvage: A nineteenth-century Paris concert salon with an empty guitar on a chair and an old camera on a tripod, a woman seen from behind standing in the middle of the room.
royan-la-professeure-de-francais: A seaside apartment building stairwell in Royan, a woman seen from behind sitting on the stairs with a schoolbag, a window showing the ocean and modernist white buildings.
la-vengeance-m-appartient: A lawyer's office in Bordeaux with case files on a desk, an open window onto elegant stone facades, a woman seen from behind looking out, a child's drawing pinned to the wall.
le-bon-denis: A luxury hotel lobby in Los Angeles with palm trees outside, and in a dreamlike overlay a road in the Beauce wheat fields and the coast of Dakar, a girl seen from behind.
ma-cherie: An empty armchair facing an open door of a neat house, a woman's coat gone from the hook, a path leading out to an open landscape and the sea.
les-fondements-economiques-et-culturels-: A large map of Africa made of wax-print fabric pieces joined together, with dams, solar panels and factories on rivers and plains, a sunrise over the continent.
anteriorite-des-civilisations-negres: Ancient Egyptian temple columns and pyramids along the Nile, papyrus reeds, smooth undecorated stone, African figures seen from afar in profile silhouettes.
civilisation-ou-barbarie: A timeline landscape from the East African rift valley to the Nile pyramids to a modern African university, ancient tools, a geometric mathematical diagram carved in stone.
alerte-sous-les-tropiques: A 1950s student room in Paris with an old typewriter on a wooden desk, a stack of plain blank papers, tropical plants on the windowsill, a map of Africa pinned to the wall.
l-empire-peul-du-macina: The inner Niger delta in the nineteenth century, a walled earthen city by the river, horsemen and herds of cattle seen from afar, mud-brick mosque towers.
vie-et-enseignement-de-tierno-bokar: A humble courtyard in Bandiagara with a wise old man in white robes seen from behind teaching seated disciples under a tree, prayer beads, the Dogon cliffs in the distance.
koumen: A young Fulani herdsman seen from behind in the bush walking toward a series of sunlit clearings, cattle with lyre-shaped horns, a tiny bearded spirit figure among the trees, a serpent in the grass.
kaidara: Three travellers seen from behind descending into a glowing underground land of gold, strange symbolic animals and objects along the path, a radiant presence in the depths.
aspects-de-la-civilisation-africaine: A village palaver tree where elders sit in a circle, a griot with a kora, a mosque and a sacred grove side by side, symbols of the human person drawn in the sand.
l-eclat-de-la-grande-etoile: A young king seen from behind on a terrace of an earthen palace at night, a great bright star shining above the savanna, an old initiate guiding him, a ritual bath of water nearby.
jesus-vu-par-un-musulman: A quiet Sahelian mosque courtyard at dawn next to a small chapel, a prayer mat and an open book on a low wooden stand, an olive branch, a star above.
petit-bodiel-et-autres-contes-de-la-sava: A small cunning hare in the African savanna leading a huge elephant and a lion, baobab trees, golden grass, a big sun.
njeddo-dewal-mere-de-la-calamite: A terrifying sorceress seen from behind casting dark storms over a fertile land of herds and villages, a small brave child with a staff standing on a hill facing her.
oui-mon-commandant: A colonial administration office in 1920s West Africa, a young African clerk seen from behind at a desk with ledgers and an inkwell, a French flag on the veranda, a horse and riders on the road.
sur-les-traces-d-amkoullel-l-enfant-peul: A photographer's camera on a tripod facing the Bandiagara cliffs and a mud-brick village by the Niger river, old photo prints scattered on a mat.
il-n-y-a-pas-de-petite-querelle: Two lizards fighting on a village wall over a drop of honey, a cat and a dog about to join, villagers in the distance about to quarrel, a baobab.
lettre-a-la-france-negre: A pile of open letters and envelopes on a Paris café table, a fountain pen, a stamp-less postcard of the Eiffel Tower, a mask of irony made of paper cut-outs.
les-mille-et-une-bibles-du-sexe: A 1960s Paris boudoir with velvet drapes, a stack of manuscript pages tied with a ribbon, a single rose, a carnival mask on a pillow.
